phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, around 3 minutes, with both players having heavy technology investment and moderate production. Opponent posture is unknown, but economy is heavy.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you observe the opponent's first combat units or when you reach the next timing window around 5 minutes.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on economy and tech, keep defense up, build a flexible ground core, and be ready to adapt to air if needed.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and technology while maintaining a defensive posture. Strengthen your ground army as a baseline, but remain flexible to transition to air if scouting suggests.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Stabilization
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single army composition without scouting information; avoid neglecting defensive structures or overbuilding production without sufficient economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, around 5-6 minutes, with the opponent showing a ground posture (Zealots observed). Your own army is still undefined, but you have a heavy economy and defense.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you gain information about their tech path.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Build up ground forces, keep economy and tech growing, maintain defense, and watch for air transitions.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army to match the opponent's ground-oriented composition. Continue increasing your economy and technology, and maintain a defensive posture.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Ground Commitment
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground forces without ensuring anti-air capability; avoid neglecting scouting for potential air transitions.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, around 9 minutes, with the opponent showing a ground posture (Zealots, Stalkers, Oracles). Your own army has transitioned to an air-heavy composition with Void Rays.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent builds significant anti-air (e.g., Stalkers, Archons) or if you need to transition back to ground.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Build up air forces, keep economy strong, maintain defense, and be ready to adapt if opponent counters.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your air army and increasing your economy. Maintain a defensive posture while developing your air superiority.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air without ensuring ground defense; avoid neglecting anti-air capabilities of the opponent.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, around 10-12 minutes, with the opponent showing a ground posture (Zealots, Stalkers, Immortals, Oracles). Your own army is ground-oriented but has added Void Rays.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to focus on a single composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add air units to your ground army, keep economy and defense up, and stay flexible.
phase_policies.target: Increase your air presence and strengthen your air army. Continue increasing your economy and maintain a defensive posture.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Air Integration
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground defense while focusing on air; avoid overcommitting to a single composition without scouting.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
